feature.title: Report overdue tasks
feature.request: Add an exported function `overdueTasks(tasks, today)` to `src/report.mjs`. It returns the open tasks whose due date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) is before `today`, oldest due date first and then lowest identifier. A task due on `today`, a task without a due date, and a task that is done are not overdue. It leaves its input list unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-001: `overdueTasks` returns the open tasks due before the given day
AC-002: A task due on the given day is not overdue
AC-003: A task without a due date is never overdue
AC-004: The oldest due date comes first, then the lowest identifier
AC-005: The input list is left alone
